_comment: Machine-readable copy of docs/factory/CHARTER.md. Load-bearing: agents never edit this file. Change it only in a human PR reviewed under CODEOWNERS, then run `python3 .factory/scripts/factory.py config-hashes --update`.
_load_bearing_package_json_fields: Changes to these package.json fields are load-bearing because the gates run them or read them: scripts, engines, packageManager, overrides, workspaces, and embedded test, coverage, lint and transpiler configuration.

models._comment: The verifier uses a different model from the implementer (writer never grades its own work; spec §5).

_tier2: Phase B: Tier 2 (UI, public API, larger changes) may run unattended only when its hand-off cites a spec folder whose spec, plan and tasks are all approved (SPEC_NOT_APPROVED otherwise). Tier 3 never runs unattended.

dependency_policy._comment: Lockfile gate (spec §6.5). Every package resolves from an allowed registry with an sha512 integrity hash; no git, file or URL specifiers; packages with install scripts must be listed (install scripts never run in agent jobs: npm ci --ignore-scripts).

allowed_workflow_secrets._comment: The only secrets workflows may reference besides GITHUB_TOKEN. Each is optional, bound to named jobs, and never present in an agent job or the sandbox. Deploy secrets live in GitHub Environments (production with required reviewers).

FACTORY_HOLDOUT_APP_KEY.purpose: GitHub App private key for optional holdout scenarios; mints a read-only token in the holdouts job, which runs no agent or candidate code

DEPLOY_TOKEN.purpose: Deploy credential for the chosen provider (Fly deploy token or Render deploy hook URL); environment secret

DEPLOY_SSH_KEY.purpose: SSH key for the ssh deploy adapter; environment secret

FACTORY_PUBLISH_APP_KEY.purpose: Optional Phase F publishing identity: GitHub App private key; mints a per-run installation token for branch push, PR and labels

FACTORY_MERGE_APP_KEY.purpose: Dedicated merge GitHub App for qualified Tier 0 auto-merge (spec §9.6); ruleset bypass actor; environment secret in factory-merge (default branch only); used only by the merge job, which runs no repository code

auto_merge._comment: Qualified auto-merge for narrow Tier 0 classes (spec §9.6; owner decision 2026-11-04). Off until a class qualifies on this repository's evidence and a human records the decision. Revocation is automatic: an escape, a revert, a model or harness change, or a red-team failure returns the class to human review. Tier 1-3 never auto-merge in 0.x.
auto_merge._factory_authors_note: Logins that publish factory PRs. With the optional publish App (Phase F), replace with that App's bot login, e.g. my-factory-publisher[bot].

qualification.human_acceptance_floor: pass^k must be at or above the class's human acceptance rate

docs.description: Documentation-only changes produced by the factory (Tier 0, fast gates).

dependency-patch.description: Dependabot patch-level bumps of existing dependencies (package.json versions and package-lock.json only).
